records.academicNote: Relevant recognised bachelor OR assessed equivalent/academic/professional attainment. The overview explicitly welcomes non-technical backgrounds: no prior AI, technical or strong mathematical background is required. Part-time is for HONG KONG RESIDENTS ONLY; the user must explicitly select the supported category. No numeric GPA admission floor.

Common items are degree/proof of study, transcript with grading explanation and applicable English evidence, translations and conditional qualification verification. Do NOT upload HKID where the official checklist excludes it; local verification occurs at registration. This platform collects no private documents. English CV and an English personal statement of about 200–300 words; reference letters IF ANY. No universal two-referee requirement inferred.

records.academicNote: Relevant bachelor/equivalent and an admission interview panel. CHINESE instruction and Chinese literary/research readiness need separate assessment; IELTS 6 / old TOEFL 60 does not establish Chinese proficiency. Part-time applications have NOT been accepted since AY2018/19. Global Chinese Studies is a concentration, not another degree. Progression 2.50, graduation 2.67 and distinction 3.50 are not entry GPA floors.
records.documentNote: Official application requires the programme-specific checklist. Do NOT upload HKID where the official checklist excludes it; local verification occurs at registration. This platform collects no private documents. Admission interview is required; no programme-specific numeric referee count or statement word limit is established in the consulted page. Visa application and graduation fees remain separate.

records.academicNote: Relevant recognised bachelor OR equivalent qualification OR satisfactory academic/professional attainment, assessed individually. No exhaustive undergraduate subject list or numeric admission GPA is established. IELTS 7 and undergraduate/first-term GPA 3.5 in the scholarship section are not the ordinary IELTS 6.5 admission floor or a universal GPA gate.
records.documentNote: Official application requires the programme-specific checklist. No programme-specific referee count or statement length established in the consulted admission panel. Current dates and older fee tables are kept separate.

records.academicNote: Relevant bachelor/equivalent; applicants without a relevant degree can be considered exceptionally on evidence of equivalent academic/professional attainment or outstanding professional achievement. Students without proven undergraduate art-history preparation must take one art-history elective after entry. Optional internships/field trips outside Hong Kong incur extra charges and are not treated as compulsory overseas delivery.
records.documentNote: Official application requires the programme-specific checklist. Common items are degree/proof of study, transcript with grading explanation and applicable English evidence, translations and conditional qualification verification. Do NOT upload HKID where the official checklist excludes it; local verification occurs at registration. This platform collects no private documents. Mandatory personal statement of 500–1,200 words. English writing samples, internship credentials and a portfolio IF ANY are ADVISED supporting materials, not universally mandatory portfolios.

records.academicNote: Relevant fields explicitly include English, literature, linguistics, communication, media studies and business; equivalent qualifications or academic/professional attainment are assessed individually. IELTS 7 / TOEFL 97 or 5.0 are preference/scholarship criteria, NOT the ordinary IELTS 6 / TOEFL 79 or 4.0 admission floor. A lower-score case-by-case consideration is not an automatic waiver.
records.documentNote: Official application requires the programme-specific checklist. Common items are degree/proof of study, transcript with grading explanation and applicable English evidence, translations and conditional qualification verification. Do NOT upload HKID where the official checklist excludes it; local verification occurs at registration. This platform collects no private documents. At least ONE confidential referee, by sealed signed post or direct official company/university email. Overseas-university graduates must arrange an official transcript directly from their Registry to the programme. Whole-degree English MOI proof must be officially stamped/signed. Do not invent an extra statement word count or a relative referee deadline.

records.academicNote: One existing degree identity: the old DHGA site says it changes to Chinese History and Digital Humanities in 2027/28 and links the new CHDH site, but the central directory still marks the proposed title/curriculum subject to approval. Approval status remains UNCONFIRMED; no second degree is created. The new site accepts a recognised bachelor/equivalent and welcomes diverse backgrounds without a history/digital-humanities prerequisite. Graduation GPA is not an entry threshold.
records.documentNote: Official application requires the programme-specific checklist. Do NOT upload HKID where the official checklist excludes it; local verification occurs at registration. This platform collects no private documents. New CHDH site refers to general admission requirements. The OLD DHGA checklist has a CV and around 500-word English statement; these remain old/provisional instructions until confirmed for the renamed cohort. The old 2026 deadline is not copied to 2027.

records.academicNote: The programme targets politics, social sciences, humanities, law, communications, business and other relevant training; recognised bachelor/equivalent or academic/professional attainment remains individually assessed. Interviews may be conducted when needed. Full-time only in the current directory; do not invent a part-time option.
records.documentNote: Official application requires the programme-specific checklist. Do NOT upload HKID where the official checklist excludes it; local verification occurs at registration. This platform collects no private documents. Personal statement and recommendation letters IF ANY; no required referee count or statement word limit established.

records.academicNote: The official department and 21 October 2026 university announcement identify the same former Translation Studies degree as Language, Communication, and Technology, effective for 2027/28. Keep P018 and the old title as a search/evidence alias; do not add another degree. Relevant bachelor/equivalent or assessed attainment; strong CHINESE AND ENGLISH competence is expected. A copied application paragraph still says proposed/pending and uses the old title, so portal naming/curriculum details need confirmation.
records.documentNote: Official application requires the programme-specific checklist. Do NOT upload HKID where the official checklist excludes it; local verification occurs at registration. This platform collects no private documents. Interview may be requested. The new programme page still contains an old-title application instruction; exact OAS naming needs confirmation. No admission statement length/referee count is inferred from dissertation/capstone word counts.

records.academicNote: Relevant bachelor/equivalent or satisfactory academic/professional attainment. The common requirements cover both ordinary MCS and its Digital Media and Culture concentration; no independently verified concentration route is created. English/Chinese instruction requires separate language-readiness judgement. Graduation requirements are not undergraduate admission GPA floors.
records.documentNote: Official application requires the programme-specific checklist. Do NOT upload HKID where the official checklist excludes it; local verification occurs at registration. This platform collects no private documents. Programme-specific English evidence and equivalents are assessed individually. Do not infer referee count or personal statement word limits from a sibling programme.

records.academicNote: Recognised bachelor/equivalent or case-by-case academic/professional attainment, with CHINESE instruction. Concentration entry additionally requires relevant academic/work evidence and portfolio/awards/supporting material; do not impose these on every general MLS applicant. Applied Sports and Health Science is FALL INTAKE ONLY; other concentrations and general MLS are not independently verified routes.
records.documentNote: Official application requires the programme-specific checklist. Common items are degree/proof of study, transcript with grading explanation and applicable English evidence, translations and conditional qualification verification. Do NOT upload HKID where the official checklist excludes it; local verification occurs at registration. This platform collects no private documents. English personal statement; supplementary CV in English if useful, concentration evidence where applicable. Confidential referee forms go by SEALED POST to MLS as soon as possible and NO LATER THAN THE OFFICIAL PROGRAMME DEADLINE; no numeric referee count or invented 14-day OAS clock. Spring 2027 applicants must choose the 2026–27 application portal.

records.academicNote: Relevant recognised bachelor/equivalent or individually assessed academic/professional attainment. CHINESE instruction; lower English IELTS 5.5/old TOEFL 46 does not establish Chinese readiness. Selected applicants take Economics (30 hours) and Mathematics/Statistics (20 hours) pre-entry courses. The conditional 42-hour Advanced Business Communication course is a graduation condition for specified minimum-English/equivalent entrants, not a higher universal admission score.
records.documentNote: Official application requires the programme-specific checklist. Common items are degree/proof of study, transcript with grading explanation and applicable English evidence, translations and conditional qualification verification. Do NOT upload HKID where the official checklist excludes it; local verification occurs at registration. This platform collects no private documents. Consent for academic-award verification. OAS sends nominated referees an invitation to submit within 14 DAYS; applicants must NOT read/upload completed confidential forms. No numeric referee count established.

records.academicNote: Relevant good first degree OR a recognised first degree plus RELEVANT WORK EXPERIENCE, with equivalents individually assessed. Experience is an ALTERNATIVE pathway, without a numeric universal years floor. Insufficient Economics/Finance background may require pre-term Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, Mathematics/Statistics or Financial Management preparation. Ordinary Hong Kong award only; optional overseas double-master arrangements remain separate.
records.documentNote: Official application requires the programme-specific checklist. Do NOT upload HKID where the official checklist excludes it; local verification occurs at registration. This platform collects no private documents. Consent for academic-award verification. OAS sends nominated referees an invitation to submit within 14 DAYS; applicants must NOT read/upload completed confidential forms. No numeric referee count established. Older FAQ describes signed original forms and an old 2026 window; this is not silently substituted for the current OAS instructions.

records.academicNote: Relevant bachelor or related certification/equivalent qualification and experience assessed individually. BASIC COMPUTING KNOWLEDGE is required; prior data-analysis familiarity is only PREFERRED. Interview can assess motivation/competence for less directly relevant degrees. The source marks English requirements SUBJECT TO SENATE APPROVAL. Old scholarship GPA 3.0/3.2 is not an entry floor.
records.documentNote: Official application requires the programme-specific checklist. Do NOT upload HKID where the official checklist excludes it; local verification occurs at registration. This platform collects no private documents. Programme-specific language/test-format and basic-computing conditions need confirmation; no numeric referee count or statement length established from the consulted panels.

records.academicNote: Relevant bachelor/equivalent or satisfactory academic/professional attainment. NON-PSYCHOLOGY degree holders must complete a pre-entry course: two modules totalling 60 hours, with an extra fee not numerically established, or approved equivalent courses. Shortlisted applicants are interviewed. Optional double degree/overseas study is separate; professional recognition and visa/employment outcomes are not guaranteed by this platform.
records.documentNote: Official application requires the programme-specific checklist. Do NOT upload HKID where the official checklist excludes it; local verification occurs at registration. This platform collects no private documents. Personal statement and reference letters IF ANY. Conditional CHSI/CSCSE/HKCAAVQ verification follows the applicant qualifications; no universal two-referee requirement or statement length inferred.

records.academicNote: Recognised bachelor or equivalent qualifications/experience, assessed individually. Counselling Psychology is an optional concentration. Do not treat completion as automatic professional licensure or a guaranteed clinical career.
records.documentNote: Official application requires the programme-specific checklist. Conditional CHSI/CSCSE/HKCAAVQ verification follows the applicant qualifications; no universal two-referee requirement or statement length inferred.

records.academicNote: Recognised bachelor/equivalent qualifications and experience assessed individually; graduates from OTHER BACKGROUNDS are welcomed. Relevant social-science study or policy work is an ADMISSION PREFERENCE, not a universal subject/work-years gate. All applicants are interviewed before an offer. Social Research and Social Innovation are concentrations, not additional degrees.
records.documentNote: Official application requires the programme-specific checklist. Do NOT upload HKID where the official checklist excludes it; local verification occurs at registration. This platform collects no private documents. Personal statement of NO MORE THAN TWO A4 PAGES and TWO recommendation letters in sealed envelopes to the programme office. All-applicant interviews; no invented relative referee clock.

records.academicNote: Relevant recognised bachelor/equivalent or satisfactory academic/professional attainment. Top-20%, GPA 3.50 and distinction conditions belong to performance scholarships after study.
records.documentNote: Official application requires the programme-specific checklist. Do NOT upload HKID where the official checklist excludes it; local verification occurs at registration. This platform collects no private documents. TWO referees and TWO recommendation letters: sealed originals to the programme team OR upload directly to OAS. Personal statement has no established numeric word limit; do not borrow Economics OAS 14-day invitations.

records.academicNote: Relevant fields include Sociology, Psychology, Political Science, Economics, Public Policy and Data Science; equivalents/academic/professional attainment are assessed individually. Prior statistics training is NOT REQUIRED; research-methods/descriptive-statistics familiarity is an advantage only. A one-week pre-entry workshop and self-study resources are organised. All applicants are interviewed.
